request.query: SELECT c.cokey, c.compname, c.comppct_r, r.reskind, r.resdept_r FROM SDA_Get_Mukey_from_intersection_with_WktWgs84('point(-93.620000 42.030000)') AS k INNER JOIN component c ON c.mukey = k.mukey LEFT JOIN corestrictions r ON r.cokey = c.cokey WHERE c.majcompflag = 'Yes' ORDER BY c.comppct_r DESC, c.cokey, r.resdept_r
